name: live-todo
description: Realtime todo + presence demo for @velajs/vela/live: node transport and Cloudflare Durable Object variants, driven by the published @velajs/client.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && swc src -d dist --strip-leading-paths && tsc --noEmit
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:web && node dist/server-node.js
scripts.start:cf: pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:web && wrangler dev --port 8789
